### Added

- (agent-platform) [Show workspace setup notices as turn status, not as the agent's reply](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3288) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In a session started in a workspace, a setup notice such as `Workspace setup: 3 repositories not updated` shows as a status alert above the agent's answer, with git's output folded under `Technical details`, instead of reading as the agent's reply.
- (agent-platform) [Show an MCP server's sign-in the session waits on, and continue once signed in](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3291) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — When an agent on a runtime such as Claude Code or Codex needs your sign-in to a connector, the session shows a sign-in card with `Sign in ↗` and `Not now`, and the agent continues by itself once you've signed in. Needs muster 5.53.0 or later.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.25.9...v3.26.0
